claims.text: This ledger reports the scoped TockTeam parity contract and residual Tockbot behaviors; it does not claim exhaustive Tockbot or Obsidian parity.

residualCapabilities.title: CodeMirror Source editor substrate
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron /tocktutor Source mode: open, edit, select, save, switch tabs, and restart without source normalization.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: replace the route Source textarea with a source-preserving CodeMirror adapter.

residualCapabilities.title: Source selection and editing extensions
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Source mode: exercise multiple cursors, rectangular selection, line edits, no-format paste, folds, task/comment decorations, and source recovery.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: port bounded keyboard, selection, decoration, and fold behavior without changing unsupported source text.

residualCapabilities.title: Milkdown Live Preview editor substrate
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron /tocktutor Live Preview: edit, undo/redo, switch tabs, restore workspace state, and dispose the editor during route changes.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: replace line-based Live Preview textareas with one source-preserving Milkdown editor.

residualCapabilities.title: Live Preview block interaction parity
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Live Preview: toggle tasks, callout types/folds, comments, heading/list folds, properties, hard breaks, and line commands with keyboard and pointer.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: complete source-preserving block widgets and history-safe Live Preview transactions.

residualCapabilities.title: Live Preview tables and command routing
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Live Preview: navigate and mutate GFM tables, use formatting/slash commands, preview links, drag/drop content, and preserve undo history.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: port bounded table, command, link-preview, template, and drag/drop behavior through the existing editor owner.

residualCapabilities.title: Bounded recursive note, media, Canvas, and Base resolution
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron fixture vault: resolve exact-path and unambiguous basename targets recursively to depth three while rejecting cycles, traversal, ambiguity, and stale generations.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: replace first-level projection with one cancellable, target-stable, bounded resolver shared by every presentation mode.

residualCapabilities.title: Local embed presentation in Reading, Slides, and export
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Reading and Slides: render nested note/Canvas/Base and local image/audio/video/PDF fixtures, then inspect inert HTML/PDF output and cleanup.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: consume the shared resolver in live views; static export keeps non-image media metadata-only and no active network resources.

residualCapabilities.title: Selection-aware Source and Live Preview embed widgets
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Source and Live Preview: activate nested media, note, Canvas, Base, Mermaid, and math widgets, then select/click to restore exact authored source.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: add target-stable widgets without recreating editor instances or losing selection and history.

residualCapabilities.title: Bounded sanitized raw HTML subset
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron Reading and export: render allowed static text/table tags and prove scripts, handlers, unsafe URLs, frames, styles, forms, and malformed markup stay inert.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: port only the reviewed static raw-HTML subset; retain deny-by-default Desktop export validation.

residualCapabilities.title: Credential-free external image and web embeds
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron live embed flow: load only validated credential-free external image/YouTube/Twitter/X/HTTP(S) content in the isolated viewer and inspect blocked private/credential URLs.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: route live external content through the existing hardened frame; saved HTML/PDF remains inert by explicit security policy.

residualCapabilities.title: Trusted named-vault and cross-vault protocol routing
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron: issue overlapping choose-vault, named/recent-vault, shorthand, and absolute-path requests against copied vaults and verify canonical identity, dirty-save gating, and latest-request-wins.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: resolve names and absolute paths only in trusted Desktop/Host ownership; browser payloads remain opaque.

residualCapabilities.title: Protocol pane, clipboard, mutation, and callback behavior
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron: exercise tab/split/window panes, clipboard content, append/prepend/overwrite, heading/block jumps, and x-success/x-error callbacks with exact completion.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: finish trusted protocol delivery through existing dispatch, pop-out, clipboard, and dirty-save owners.

residualCapabilities.title: TockDriver-compatible note search and read tools
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Disposable DSH headless model task: invoke notes_search and notes_read against a non-guessable fixture, return exact bounded canonical JSON, then verify cancellation and vault replacement fail closed.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: add thin notes_* aliases over the existing generation-bound noteVault reads without a second scanner.

residualCapabilities.title: TockDriver-compatible staged write and organize-capture tools
residualCapabilities.realConsumerCheck: Disposable packaged Desktop model flow: stage create/update and organize-capture proposals, review/approve or reject them, and verify no mutation before approval plus restart recovery.
residualCapabilities.disposition: Residual: expose thin notes_* staged-write aliases over the existing reviewed proposal queue and audit authority.

retainedDivergences.title: Static HTML/PDF export of network-backed content
retainedDivergences.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron HTML/PDF export with external image, YouTube, Twitter/X, and HTTP(S) fixtures; inspect that saved output contains no active remote resource.
retainedDivergences.securityRationale: Saved HTML/PDF is an inert artifact and must not disclose export activity or create a network authority. Live external content belongs behind the isolated Web Viewer boundary.
retainedDivergences.disposition: Retained security divergence from Tockbot export behavior; live Reading/Slides support does not authorize static output to fetch remote content.

retainedDivergences.title: Static HTML/PDF export of audio, video, and PDF resources
retainedDivergences.realConsumerCheck: Packaged Electron HTML/PDF export with local audio/video/PDF fixtures; inspect that output retains labeled metadata rather than active media resource elements.
retainedDivergences.securityRationale: The Desktop static exporter accepts only bounded data-image resources. Keeping audio, video, and PDF as metadata avoids widening the saved artifact resource surface.
retainedDivergences.disposition: Retained security divergence from Tockbot export behavior; interactive local media remains available only in live views or the in-app preview owner.
